append.detail: CLOSED 2026-09-29 (ADR-1640). Premise re-tested first: reportContent validated the target type and that an id was sent, then inserted through the admin client. Between Missing report target and from('reports').insert it read only reports (the duplicate-pending check). WHAT CLOSED IT: reportTargetExists does one keyed read per type (posts for post and comment, dispatches, profiles, events, spotlight_guestbook) before the insert; a missing row or a non-UUID id returns fail('Invalid report target'), the same line as a bad type. Comments are posts with parent_id set. No migration: reports.target_id stays a UUID with no FK. Tests: app/(main)/feed/report-actions.test.ts (source-shape of the missing read, one case per type). PROBE: the existing cmd now passes.
